messages:
Mai Tran: Heads up — in the compare table compact rows prototype I noticed the row action chevrons overlap the performance badge tooltip when density is set to 'tight'. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/shot.png :eyes:
Jordan Lee: ah yea saw that too. tooltip gets clipped and then keyboard focus jumps weirdly when you tab through actions
Sanjay Patel: repro steps? I can try locally
Mai Tran: open model catalog, toggle View → Compact, hover the perf badge on the rightmost column, then hover the action chevron next to it. Tooltip should appear behind the action button.
Carmen Ruiz: cc @UX-bot this feels like a z-index and a11y focus order issue. also copy on the tooltip says "perf score" — can we use "latency / cost" instead for clarity?
UX-bot: Suggestion: change tooltip copy to "Perf (latency · cost)" and increase tooltip z-index to 1200. Recommend 100ms tooltip show delay to avoid flicker during quick hovers.
Jordan Lee: 100ms delay seems fine. we should avoid making tooltips stick too long tho. 300ms hide delay?
Sanjay Patel: implementation note — the action chevrons render in a separate portal right now (for overflow), which explains z-index. quick fix: render badges/actions in the same stacking context or give portal an explicit z-index and aria-hidden toggle while tooltip is open.
Mai Tran: keyboard flow: when tabbing, the badge tooltip appears but disappears before screen reader can read. any ideas for SR behavior?
Carmen Ruiz: for SR, we should prefer using aria-live or an offscreen text alternative rather than relying on visual tooltip. tooltip should be purely visual and the badge should have an aria-label like "Performance: 92 — latency 120ms, cost $0.002/token"
Jordan Lee: agree. also the compact row's hit target for the chevron is only 18px, per a11y that's too small. bump to 24px min.
Sanjay Patel: quick CSS patch I tried: 
```
.catalog-row .action-portal { z-index: 1200; }
.tooltip { transition-delay: 100ms; transition-duration: 140ms; }
.action-button { min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; }
```
seems to fix overlap locally.
Mai Tran: nice. can you open a tiny PR with that and wire the aria-label change? we should also update the tooltip copy in the design tokens file (components/tooltip/strings.ts).
Jordan Lee: will do. for version pinning UX: if a user pins a version and we collapse badges for tight rows, the pin icon disappears visually. can we surface a small dot or outline even in compact mode so users know something is pinned?
Carmen Ruiz: +1. maybe show a subtle left-side stripe (2px) with the pin color in compact mode — accessible contrast required.
UX-bot: Accessibility check: left stripe must meet 3:1 contrast at compact width. Provide fallback of a 4px stripe or an icon badge if contrast fails.
Mai Tran: let's aim for stripe + icon on hover. Jordan, add to PR: compact-mode stripe + aria-pressed state for pinned rows.
Jordan Lee: noted. I'll include screenshots, tests for keyboard tab order, and an a11y note in the PR description.
Sanjay Patel: Awesome. tagging @eng-frontend for visibility. :thumbsup:
Mai Tran: thanks everyone — moving this to a quick PR and I'll follow up on the copy update in the design tokens review tomorrow.
